title: The indiscernible distinctness axioms use the language as the indexing set.
details: McNulty, Elementary Model Theory (Fall2011), Section8.3 printed p.88, displayed definition of Delta: the inequalities between fresh constants are indexed by r,s in L, although the new constants name the ordered set D. Repair the displayed indexing set to D and require inequalities for all distinct indices. The theorem and the surrounding construction make the intended distinct skeleton clear; the corpus uses the corrected family explicitly.
